style: Flat folk-art illustration for a bright daytime mobile game in an embroidered countryside style: saturated cobalt blue (#1763DE) and sunflower yellow (#FFC01F) dominate, with cream linen (#FFF6E4), deep navy (#0E2350) hand-drawn outlines and tiny red cross-stitch diamond accents, poster-flat shading, high-noon light, cheerful and bold.
